Cc: Alex Singh <alex.singh@orbigrid.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jan 2028 13:12:00 -0500
Subject: Quick demo request — multi-team (AE/SE/IT)

Hi Grace / Marissa,

We signed up for the self-serve trial and would like a focused 45-min demo that includes our AE, SE, and IT/security folks. Goal is to:
- Walk through the platform with a short POC scope
- Confirm SSO and network requirements for our staging environment
- Discuss expected latency/throughput for 10k monthly calls

People: Samira Khan (Product), Alex Singh (IT/Security) — both on this thread. We are distributed: I’m in EST, Alex is in IST (India). Prefer next week between 1/13–1/15; mornings for me (EST) or evening for Alex (IST) work.

Can you propose a couple of windows that cover both sides, or do a staggered window where AE/SE present at an overlapping core?

Thanks — Samira
OrbiGrid Systems
[Attachment: OrbiGrid-trial-context.md (TXT)]

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@orbigrid.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Alex Singh <alex.singh@orbigrid.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jan 2028 14:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Quick demo request — multi-team (AE/SE/IT)

Hi Samira — great to meet you (virtually).

We can absolutely do that. To cover both EST and IST I usually offer two patterns:
1) Overlap window (45 min): 8:30am–9:15am EST / 6:00pm–6:45pm IST — AE + SE + IT all on the call
2) Staggered (split): 30-minute technical session with SE + IT for Alex (9:30pm IST / 11:00am EST), followed by a 30-minute product + next-steps with AE for the broader team 11:30am EST (shorter overlap)

Options next week (all EST):
- Tue 1/13 11:00am–11:45am EST
- Wed 1/14 8:30am–9:15am EST
- Thu 1/15 11:30am–12:15pm EST

Marissa (AE) — looping you in to pick the best cadence and confirm SE availability. Alex — are any of these workable for you? If not, tell us a preferred evening IST slot and we’ll adapt.

Cheers,
Grace
SDR, Redwood Inference
[Calendars: please reply with preferred slot]

Samira — thanks for the context. We’ll plan a 45-minute overlap session if possible (pattern #1) so Alex can meet the AE + SE and we can do a short tech deep-dive.

Karthik — can you join Wed 1/14 8:30am–9:15am EST (which is ~6:00pm IST) for the SE-led portion? If not, we’ll move to the staggered pattern. Jonas will join for the product/contract signals.

Alex / Samira — two quick asks before we lock the calendar:
- Alex: please confirm whether you want SSO (SAML) enabled for the session or if you prefer a break-glass demo (no SSO). If SSO, Karthik will need to review the SSO_Checklist.docx I’ve attached.
- Any ports or IP allowlists we should prepare? If so, share the CIDR/IP range.

Attached: Redwood-demo-agenda.pdf (short run of show), SSO_Checklist.docx

Thanks — Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

- We prefer a pre-security-only 20-min screen share to validate SAML metadata and network egress if possible (can be earlier the same day).
- For the demo environment we need the list of egress IPs (or an allowlist range) and any recommended timeouts.
- SSO is preferred. I reviewed the SSO_Checklist.docx and Karthik may need the metadata XML and ACS URL. Can you confirm where to upload metadata or if you support IdP-initiated flows?

For scheduling: Wed 1/14 8:30am EST works for me (6:00pm IST). If something changes on our side I’ll flag by EOD Fri 1/12.

Alex Singh
